name: mirage
text: Refresh: v1.0.30 is out (https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.30). The arrow now shows for about 1 second and goes, and a strip at the top of the screen names what is being read (engine status, orders, bids, API usage, messages and chat) until the pull ends. Wallet target: you're right, it made no sense beside 400%. I removed the separate 'Wallet target' buttons; the bids now always aim for the 'Most the bids up may be worth' number you type or pick (400%), the Diagnostics check uses the same number, and the engine's bid desk does too. That is v1.0.31, in the release gate now; I'll post the link when it's out. Also noticed in your screenshot: the engine was 'Not responding' for 43 min, which fits you having switched it off.
